# Richard Verver, JCL, Canon Lawyer

> Canon lawyer and ecclesiastical judge since 2015. Catholic annulment cases, penal defence and recourse against Church decrees. Free consultation, Canada & U.S.

Every essay under /essays/ and every page of the homeschool curriculum is dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/): copy, quote, translate, republish and learn from them for any purpose, without asking. Quotations from other writers keep their own terms. Other pages are not covered by that dedication, and nothing on the site is legal advice for a particular case.

## Site

- [Canon Lawyer in Toronto](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/)
- [Canon Law Services](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/services/): Canon law services: advocacy in annulment (marriage nullity) cases, penal defence, recourse against decrees, and consulting for dioceses and institutes.
- [About: Canon Lawyer & Ecclesiastical Judge](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/about/): Richard Verver, JCL: judge at the Toronto Regional Tribunal since 2015, canonical advocate, lecturer at Saint Philip's Seminary, and CCLS Treasurer.
- [Canon Law & Annulment FAQ](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/faq/): Answers about canon lawyers, Catholic annulments, canonical penal cases, recourse deadlines, fees, confidentiality and working remotely.
- [Contact a Canon Lawyer: Free Consultation](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/contact/): Book a free, confidential consultation with canon lawyer Richard Verver, JCL, by phone or video. Clients across Canada and the United States.

## Essays

- [Essays](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/): the index of this section.
- [On a People That Made Itself](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/a-people-that-made-itself/): “We the People … do ordain and establish.” A sentence spoken by a thing that does not yet exist until it is spoken. What a state is, the three answers to where authority comes from, the two American readings, what the jurists admit, and the narrow thing that actually follows. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/a-people-that-made-itself/a-people-that-made-itself.pdf
- [A Plate of Ice](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/a-plate-of-ice/): A grandmother of thirty-three years in California and a stateless father in Ohio, both taken at routine check-ins. What the Law of Moses says about the stranger who has begotten children among you, why the Church’s own law has no category for an illegal person, and what a penalty without a crime is called. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/a-plate-of-ice/a-plate-of-ice.pdf
- [The Rented Hour](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/the-rented-hour/): There is a small glowing oblong in every pocket, and inside it is a grid of twenty-minute rectangles, given away to strangers. What the digital calendar has done to the season, the promise and the feast, and to the liberty, friendship and fallow ground of the man who owns it; and the one white rectangle worth defending. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/the-rented-hour/the-rented-hour.pdf
- [The Score](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/the-score/): A man in a coffee shop looks at his hand before he looks at anything else, because a ring has scored his sleep. On wearable trackers, glucose monitors on healthy arms and the men who do not intend to die; what it does to charity to have never needed anyone; and why the devil’s cleanest trick is to make death a bug awaiting an update. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/the-score/the-score.pdf
- [The Senate at Capri](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/the-senate-at-capri/): Tiberius governed the world by letter from an island for eleven years, and the senate learned to treat every letter as a command. On remote work and the empty forum: why a vote was once a walk across a floor, why courage needs a witness as fire needs air, and why a tyrant has no need of guards when every citizen has placed himself under house arrest. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/the-senate-at-capri/the-senate-at-capri.pdf
- [Half of Nothing](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/half-of-nothing/): Not Caesar but Herod Antipas: the tetrarch who built his capital on a graveyard, took his brother’s wife, feared one man in camel hair, and had him beheaded in the middle of a party rather than be seen taking back a boast. The pattern of the petty ruler, the nation that prefers the fox in the palace to the voice in the wasteland, and the reckoning that follows. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/half-of-nothing/half-of-nothing.pdf
- [The Meekest Man That Ever Ate in Hall](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/the-meekest-man/): The young man who calls himself an alpha believes he has woken into something primal. He has become a customer. On the manosphere as the surrender to commerce it claims to escape, the men without chests it manufactures, the predator mistaken for the protector, the algorithm as a place to hide from women, and chivalry as the cure: strength that exists only to carry the burdens of the weak. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/the-meekest-man/the-meekest-man.pdf
- [The Patient Who Cannot Be Guilty](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/the-patient-who-cannot-be-guilty/): The confessional replaced by the clinic, not by denial but by translation: soul into ego, sin into trauma, absolution into self-acceptance. Why guilt is the dignity of a spirit and not a symptom, why the boundary is the death of the neighbour, why the man who works on himself for ten years never begins, and the one formula by which despair is removed. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/the-patient-who-cannot-be-guilty/the-patient-who-cannot-be-guilty.pdf
- [The Filler of Voids](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/the-filler-of-voids/): A girl dancing, a city on fire, a man selling a knife, a child under rubble, a recipe: a column of equal rectangles chosen by a process that has studied where each soul falls. On the feed as engineered gravity, the factory cadence moved into the thumb, compassion’s minimum duration, and why the hungry scroll is the refusal of the void where grace waits. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/the-filler-of-voids/the-filler-of-voids.pdf
- [Four Dreadful Words](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/four-dreadful-words/): Orwell confessed that the lower classes smell and that the flinch survived every argument. The flinch has not gone; it has moved from the nose to the ear. On the credentialed class that marches for the worker and cannot talk to the plumber, the curated résumé as the aspidistra in the window, discursive compliance in place of work, and common decency as the cure. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/four-dreadful-words/four-dreadful-words.pdf
- [Christ in the Carriage](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/christ-in-the-carriage/): A word of hope. Houselander saw Christ in every person on a crowded Bakerloo train and wrote for a city under the bombs that he was in it. For this frightened time: Christ in the man with the ring, the girl scrolling in the dark, the neighbour who voted wrongly, the woman with no bed; Advent as the dark in which he grows; and the glory to be revealed in us. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/christ-in-the-carriage/christ-in-the-carriage.pdf
- [Of Divers Weights](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/of-divers-weights/): Smith wrote that the price of monopoly is the highest which can be squeezed out of the buyers. Raised to a prophet’s pitch, he finds it in the secret personal price: surveillance pricing as the divers weights of Amos, the common price enclosed, the conspiracy that no longer needs to meet, the merchants’ fig leaves and the magistrates’ affected ignorance, and the distributist case for owning the tools. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/of-divers-weights/of-divers-weights.pdf
- [Whether the Cloud Makes Many Worlds](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/whether-the-cloud-makes-many-worlds/): The dead gather in a Toronto hall to dispute whether the digital cloud has made of us many worlds. Leibniz, Kant, Socrates and Elijah say it has. McLuhan determines that it has made no world: the table between us is hidden, the bonds beneath it never cut, and the Light that pitched his tent is not in the wind, the earthquake or the fire. With a dance track for Strudel, built from its end. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/whether-the-cloud-makes-many-worlds/whether-the-cloud-makes-many-worlds.pdf
- [What Is to Be Done?](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/what-is-to-be-done/): The question is older than Lenin: the crowds asked it of John at the Jordan, and of Peter at Pentecost. Lenin answered with a vanguard and a newspaper; the cloud has perfected both. A Leninist pamphlet against the vanguard: in defence of kustarnichestvo, the little DAG in place of the scaffolding, a charitable reading of Gregory Caridi on the three senses of unity, and the plan for a common table. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/essays/what-is-to-be-done/what-is-to-be-done.pdf

## Reflections

- [Biblical Reflections](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/reflections/): the index of this section.
- [The Four Soils Are All Yours](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/reflections/the-sower/): The parable of the sower read as a map of one life rather than a sorting of people: the seed lands on every patch, the harvest from a single good plot is out of all proportion, and the harvest comes at the end. A reflection in the register of C. S. Lewis. PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/reflections/the-sower/the-sower.pdf
- [O Radix](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/reflections/o-radix/): A parable for the Advent age: a judge who built a small program to check canons reads John 1 as a graph, asks the program whether the Logos could dwell in it, and is told where he already dwells. Speculative fiction, not teaching. PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/reflections/o-radix/o-radix.pdf
- [Here, You Have What Is Yours](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/reflections/here-you-have-what-is-yours/): The coin of tribute, the buried talent and Peter’s protest read together as three ways of handing God back what is his untouched, and the woman at Bethany who broke the jar instead. A reflection in the register of G. K. Chesterton. PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/reflections/here-you-have-what-is-yours/here-you-have-what-is-yours.pdf

## Colloquies

- [Colloquies](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/colloquies/): the index of this section.
- [The Misbegotten Objection](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/colloquies/the-misbegotten-objection/): A trialogue between Aristotle, Thomas Aquinas and a doctoral student writing on women in their work: the false biology, the architecture built on it, what the Church kept after the premise fell, and what is to be done. PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/colloquies/the-misbegotten-objection/the-misbegotten-objection.pdf
- [Phylax, or On the Spoon](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/colloquies/phylax-or-on-the-spoon/): A dialogue in a Toronto psychiatric ward. Socrates questions Phylax, who keeps it, about a spoon served with meat, signs left from a plague that has passed, earplugs instead of music, trays instead of a table, and the Rule of Benedict turned inside out. PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/colloquies/phylax-or-on-the-spoon/phylax-or-on-the-spoon.pdf

## Explainers

- [Canon Law Explainers](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/): the index of this section.
- [What Is Canon Law?](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/what-is-canon-law/): A plain-English introduction to canon law: what it is for, where it came from, what it governs, who makes it, and where an ordinary Catholic meets it. PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/what-is-canon-law/what-is-canon-law.pdf
- [Canon Law and Theology](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/canon-law-and-theology/): How Church law relates to Church teaching: what law can and cannot do, divine versus ecclesiastical law, the two forums, and why sin and penalty differ. PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/canon-law-and-theology/canon-law-and-theology.pdf
- [Your Rights in the Church](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/your-rights-in-the-church/): The rights every Catholic has under canons 208 to 223, in plain English, with an honest account of how they are exercised and where the remedies are weak. PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/your-rights-in-the-church/your-rights-in-the-church.pdf
- [Marriage Nullity, Explained](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/marriage-nullity/): What a Catholic declaration of nullity is and is not, the grounds in plain language, the process since 2015, and the rights of both spouses. PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/marriage-nullity/marriage-nullity.pdf
- [Indissolubility: What the Church Can and Cannot Dissolve](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/indissolubility/): Why the Church cannot dissolve a consummated sacramental marriage, the exceptions it does recognise, and the hard situations of separation and remarriage. PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/indissolubility/indissolubility.pdf
- [Canonical Crimes and Penalties](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/canonical-crimes/): What the Church counts as a crime, how it differs from a sin, what excuses and what reduces a penalty, and how a penal case actually moves. PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/canonical-crimes/canonical-crimes.pdf
- [Administrative Recourse: Challenging a Church Decision](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/administrative-recourse/): How a bishop’s decree can be challenged, the three steps and their short deadlines, what a recourse can and cannot win, and why silence is so common. PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/administrative-recourse/administrative-recourse.pdf
- [When the System Feels Against You](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/when-the-system-feels-against-you/): Where Church law protects you when a decision goes against you, where it does not, and the practical steps that keep your rights alive. PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/when-the-system-feels-against-you/when-the-system-feels-against-you.pdf
- [The Sacraments and the Law](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/sacraments-and-the-law/): Baptism, godparents, communion, confession, anointing, marriage and funerals: what canon law says about access to the sacraments, in plain English. PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/sacraments-and-the-law/sacraments-and-the-law.pdf
- [Clergy and Religious in Difficulty](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/clergy-and-religious-in-difficulty/): What faculties, removal, transfer, leave, precautionary measures, exclaustration and dismissal mean in law, and the rights that go with each. PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/clergy-and-religious-in-difficulty/clergy-and-religious-in-difficulty.pdf
- [Scrupulosity and the Law](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/scrupulosity/): For the scrupulous Catholic: what canon law actually asks of you in confession and before communion, why a doubtful sin is not a mortal sin, and why the God you fear cannot exist. PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/explainers/scrupulosity/scrupulosity.pdf

## Homeschool curriculum

- [The Benedict Year: a homeschool curriculum](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/): the index of this section.
- [For parents: the Benedict Year](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/for-parents/): For parents using the Benedict Year: which essays to preview and why, the books and materials, how Mr. Benedict’s tests assess the year, the warning signs of a schoolroom drifting toward L.I.V.E., and the twelve worked cases. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/for-parents/for-parents.pdf
- [Reading: Unit 1 of the Benedict Year](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/reading/): The advertisement, the tests, and sentences with two readings; the child writes the essay the map is still missing. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/reading/reading.pdf
- [Number: Unit 2 of the Benedict Year](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/number/): Morse code, the chess problem from the tests, and why order comes before measure. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/number/number.pdf
- [Nature: Unit 3 of the Benedict Year](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/nature/): The tile room, Foucault’s pendulum, and Galileo: a finding settles a fact that no censure could. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/nature/nature.pdf
- [Making: Unit 4 of the Benedict Year](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/making/): Kate’s bucket, a camera obscura, and the Whisperer: what a maker can give and what he cannot. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/making/making.pdf
- [Memory: Unit 5 of the Benedict Year](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/memory/): Mr. Benedict’s life in order, Herod’s banquet, and a forged letter caught by its dates. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/memory/memory.pdf
- [The Person: Unit 6 of the Benedict Year](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/person/): The ladder of beings, the phone feed beside the Whisperer, and Mr. Benedict asleep. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/person/person.pdf
- [Being: Unit 7 of the Benedict Year](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/being/): One word in three senses, and why God is not the top rung of the ladder. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/being/being.pdf
- [God: Unit 8 of the Benedict Year](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/god/): Rank, form and date; Christ in the carriage; the Immaculate Conception before and after 1854. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/god/god.pdf
- [The Act: Unit 9 of the Benedict Year](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/act/): The prisoner’s dilemma, a market you could send a child to, and the trolley. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/act/act.pdf
- [The City: Unit 10 of the Benedict Year](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/city/): Who is responsible for what, the senate at Capri, and judgments only those responsible can supply. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/city/city.pdf
- [Law: Unit 11 of the Benedict Year](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/law/): House rules and their reasons, a plate of ice, and the day a law begins to bind. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/law/law.pdf
- [Worship: Unit 12 of the Benedict Year](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/worship/): Matter and form, the white rectangle, and the words of baptism. Public domain (CC0 1.0). PDF: https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/curriculum/worship/worship.pdf

## Optional

- [Catholic Annulment (Marriage Nullity) Advocate](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/services/marriage-nullity/): Advocate for petitioners and respondents in Catholic annulment (marriage nullity) cases: grounds, process and timelines. Free consultation, Canada and U.S.
- [Canonical Penal Defence for Clergy & Laity](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/services/penal-advocacy/): Canonical defence for priests, deacons, religious and lay faithful facing accusations, preliminary investigations, precautionary measures or a penal process.
- [Recourse Against Church Decrees](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/services/administrative-recourse/): Challenge a bishop's decree: parish mergers, church closures, removal of pastors. Hierarchical recourse deadlines can be as short as 10 useful days.
- [Canon Law Consulting for Dioceses](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/services/dioceses-institutions/): Canonical support for bishops, tribunals and religious institutes: external judge and defender services, preliminary investigations, decrees and formation.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.canon-lawyer.ca/privacy/): How Richard Verver, JCL handles your information: no cookies or tracking on this site, encrypted email and documents, and encrypted backups.
